from system_one_adapter import AsyncSystemOneAdapterClient
from system_one_adapter.providers.openai import AsyncOpenAIProvider

async def main():

    qid, doc = mod.pairs()[0]

    ans = resp.answers[mod.QNAME]

        "doc": doc,
        "noul": float(ans.noul),
        "model": f"xai/{mod.GROK_MODEL}",
        "latencyMs": int((time.perf_counter()-t0)*1000),
        "in": int(resp.usage.input_tokens_total),
        "out": int(resp.usage.output_tokens_total),
        "state_keys": sorted(st),
        "passage_keys": sorted(st["passage"]),
    }))

asyncio.run(main())
